title: Extended DRX cycle for UEs in 5GMM-IDLE and 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication

entities.name: Extended DRX procedure
entities.description: Procedure for negotiating and using extended DRX cycles in 5GMM-IDLE mode and 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which eDRX parameters can be negotiated between UE and network.

entities.name: Requested extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element used by UE to request eDRX during registration procedure.

entities.name: Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE
entities.description: Information element provided by network to accept eDRX request during registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: State where UE can use eDRX when not in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication
entities.description: State where UE can use eDRX when not in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: No emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition that must be satisfied for UE to use eDRX.

entities.name: eDRX negotiated condition
entities.description: Condition where UE received Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE during last registration procedure.

entities.name: Use eDRX
entities.description: Property indicating that UE or network is using extended DRX cycles.

entities.name: Use UE specific DRX parameter
entities.description: Property indicating fallback to stored UE specific DRX parameters when eDRX cannot be used.

relations.description: Registration procedure may contain Requested extended DRX parameters IE when UE requests eDRX.
Registration procedure may contain Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE when network accepts eDRX request.
eDRX procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode (when not in NB-N1 mode).
eDRX procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication (when not in NB-N1 mode).
Condition where eDRX was negotiated establishes the property of using eDRX.
Condition of no emergency PDU session establishes the property of using eDRX.
Presence of Negotiated extended DRX parameters IE guards the eDRX negotiated condition.
Negation of eDRX negotiated condition establishes fallback to UE specific DRX parameters.
